title: Evaluation of the explicit additive scalar Hom map
statement: For a commutative ring Λ in Type(u+1), schemes W and S in universe u, k:W→S, a sheaf G of Λ-modules on the small etale site of W, q:ℕ, U:S.Etale, A:Over(W), and a raw derived Hom class z at A, rawModuleAbelianHomMap(Λ,k,G,q,U,A)(z) equals scalarSourceFactor(Λ,A.hom≫k,freeSheaf(Λ,S)(U),freeAbelian(S,U),freeMap(Λ,S,U)), followed by derived scalar forgetting applied to z, followed by scalarCoefficientFactor(Λ,A.hom,G,q). The factor definitions are the canonical ones of def-sbc-raw-scalar-source-factors and lem-sbc-raw-scalar-coefficient-square.

source.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8; explicit additive-map evaluation in lem-sbc-raw-module-abelian-hom-map-naturality

proof.text: Unfold rawModuleAbelianHomMap. Its additive homomorphism is derived forgetting followed by right composition with the coefficient factor and left composition with the source factor. Evaluate AddCommGrpCat.ofHom and the two additive compositions. The canonical named factors have these exact bodies, so the equality is definitional (rfl). No coherence, invertibility or restriction on q beyond q:ℕ is used; zero classes, zero sheaves, identity maps and degree zero are included.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalarHom_evaluate
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A : Over W)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op A)) :
    rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A z =
      scalarSourceFactor Λ (A.hom ≫ k) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeMap Λ S U) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map z ≫
        scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G (q : ℤ)
